points: Built an incremental dbt pipeline on Snowflake Cortex (Llama 3.1-405B) that turns 100K+ tickets and IoT alerts into repair histories for 36K+ machines, served in Slack by its own ADK agent at ~95% lower cost and 10 min → 10 sec lookup.

Shipped the first knowledge retrieval agent on a Google ADK / Gemini 2.5 Flash multi-agent architecture, grounded in a Vertex AI Search index over internal SOPs with citations and abstention. It is now the template for new agents.
Modeled operational data as Snowflake semantic views served through a Snowflake agent, wrapped in a custom MCP server registered as a tool for natural-language queries over machine data.
Built a layered evaluation harness: a retrieval regression suite plus a custom Vertex AI judge metric that scores answer correctness on every release.
Raised paraphrase quality by up to 22% (ROUGE-L / BLEU / METEOR) with domain-adaptive HuggingFace fine-tuning.
Curated 100K+ Hindi sentences using semantic similarity and POS tagging to improve training data quality.
Cut training time 20% by optimizing PyTorch training and batching; deployed with Docker, MLflow and GitHub Actions.
Built financial sentiment models (SVM, LSTM, BERT) reaching 89% accuracy and 86% F1.
Scraped and processed 20K+ financial articles with BeautifulSoup and Selenium into domain-specific NLP datasets.
Delivered the pipeline end to end, from EDA to a FastAPI deployment.

projects.title: Break The Bot
projects.summary: An automated red-teaming pipeline that throws adversarial prompts at 10+ models and scores the responses with an LLM-as-a-Judge.
points: Orchestrated on Google Cloud Composer (Airflow) with Terraform-provisioned infrastructure and DVC-versioned datasets.
LLM-as-a-Judge with Groq (Llama 3.3) scoring adversarial responses across 10+ models.
Great Expectations data-quality gates for fail-fast runs and drift detection.
Metrics served by a FastAPI service on Cloud Run (Cloud Build CI/CD) into a live Streamlit dashboard.

projects.title: Multilingual Text Detoxification
projects.summary: Rewrites toxic text into neutral text that keeps the original meaning, across 8 languages, comparing lexicon, unsupervised and fine-tuned approaches.
points: Baselines (duplicate, lexicon delete) plus an unsupervised mask-and-fill method: log-odds ratio finds toxic tokens, mBERT / XLM-RoBERTa fills them.
Fine-tuned MT0-Large with LoRA adapters on parallel toxic–neutral pairs from multilingual ParaDetox.
Scored toxicity, semantic similarity and fluency per language: English toxicity dropped 0.61 with mask-and-fill and 0.33 with MT0-LoRA.
Showed low-resource languages (Amharic, Chinese) remain hard, with minimal toxicity reduction.

projects.title: Stack Overflow Auto-Tagging
projects.summary: Multi-label tag prediction on 100K+ questions, comparing a from-scratch probabilistic model against modern transformers.
points: Hidden Markov Model written from scratch with Viterbi decoding: 68.4% micro-F1.
Benchmarked against Logistic Regression and DistilBERT baselines.
Fine-tuned DistilBERT reached 85% micro-F1.

projects.title: Spotify Recommendation System
projects.summary: Predicts which tracks belong in my favorites, using my own Spotify streaming history and each track's audio features.
points: Pulled streaming history and recovered track IDs through the Spotify Web API, caching IDs to avoid repeat calls.
Built features from audio attributes such as danceability, energy, tempo, acousticness and valence.
Balanced the classes with SMOTE and compared Logistic Regression, Decision Tree and Random Forest classifiers with grid-search tuning.

projects.title: Freelancer–Client Platform
projects.summary: A marketplace where clients post jobs and freelancers apply, with contracts, reviews and payments.
points: Node.js / Express API with 20+ endpoints for job search, applications, skills, contracts and reviews.
MySQL schema of 10 related tables covering clients, freelancers, jobs, skills, contracts, reviews and payments.
Passwords hashed with bcrypt.

projects.title: Image Transformer Application
projects.summary: A command-driven image processor with filters (sepia, blur, sharpen), RGB / luma / intensity components and flips.
points: MVC architecture with the command pattern, so new transformations plug in as new commands.
Script files drive batch processing of images end to end.

projects.title: Test Drive Management System
projects.summary: Replaces a dealership's handwritten register: customers book test drives, managers assign executives and track every drive.
points: Customer and manager roles: booking by date, time slot and model; availability checks; confirming, closing and reviewing past drives.
React frontend with a Node.js / Express API over MySQL.
